main_text.p: amore, exercetur, illius defendendi gratia, majorisque mali & quidem imminentis avertendi. In tantum etiam, ut Argum. 1.2.&3.dulce ac decorum habeatur pro D dejuft & jur.Patriæ salute & incolumitate mortis periculum intrepidè subire; cui dulcissimę vitam & omnia jure debemus. Ut singulare certamen in Patriæ commoduṁ[?] atque emolumentum suscepţum[?], sublimitatione postmodum explicandā, non tantum licitum sit, verùm insuper gloriosum. Tale fuit certamen Manlii Torquati, ita appellati, à devicto hoste Gallo, cui torquem detraxerat.

page.notes: Running head printed as small capitals "P. V O E T". The left-margin note "D dejuft & jur." is read as printed; the leading mark may be a symbol and is uncertain. The mark at lower left beside the last line is a small printer's sign, not legible as text, and is not transcribed. "suadeṭ" and "suscepţum" contain a doubtful final letter. Catchword "quod-" is at lower right. A faint digitiser watermark at lower right is omitted.
